question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Group of bees
solution:
The correct answer is: **Swarm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"swarm"** means a large or dense group of insects, especially bees, moving together. (झुंड)

 
 
• **Example: **A **swarm **of bees attacked the picnic area, causing everyone to flee.
 
 
 
• **"Group of bees" **is commonly referred to as a swarm. (मधुमक्खियों का झुंड)

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gaggle **(झुंड): A group of geese.

 
 
• **Example:** A **gaggle **of geese waddled across the road, causing a traffic jam.
 
 
 
• **Shoal **(मछलियों का झुंड): A large number of fish swimming together.
 
 
• **Example: **A **shoal **of fish darted away as the boat approached.
 
 
 
• **Pack **(झुंड): A group of animals such as wolves or dogs.
 
 
• **Example:** The **pack **of wolves prowled through the forest in search of prey.
